guarantees.claim: msg_ready_o is driven to (en_msgbuf | (keccak_ready_i & ~hold_msg)) when sel_mux equals MuxFifo; driven to 0 when sel_mux is MuxPrefix, MuxFuncPad, MuxZeroEnd, or any other value (default / MuxNone).

assumptions.claim: en_msgbuf, keccak_ready_i, and hold_msg correctly represent the respective buffer-ready, downstream keccak ready, and hold conditions.
assumptions.risk: msg_ready_o may falsely assert or deassert, causing data overflow/underflow or protocol deadlock.

uncertain_points.claim: msg_ready_o is a combinational output that depends on sel_mux and other inputs; a simultaneous transition of sel_mux and en_msgbuf or keccak_ready_i could produce a glitch on msg_ready_o before the downstream sampling edge.
uncertain_points.cond: sel_mux and the readiness signals change in the same clock cycle
uncertain_points.risk: a glitch might cause the downstream consumer to latch incorrect control causing a data-path error or deadlock.
